research_question: Within the declared finite cases, does adding a typed relation token to the witness distinguish source relations that collide under the bare context-indexed prefix projection?
hypothesis: H1: an explicitly linked typed relation token allows the bounded preservation predicate to distinguish the two relation cases; H0: the enriched witness remains insufficient or the relation identity is not linked.

independent_variables.name: witness_mode
independent_variables.definition: Whether the witness carries a typed relation token linked to the source relation

dependent_variables.name: relation_identity_match
dependent_variables.definition: Witness relation token equals the source relation identifier

dependent_variables.name: preserve_relation_candidate
dependent_variables.definition: All bounded predicate components evaluate true

dependent_variables.name: projection_collision
dependent_variables.definition: Projected endpoint pair is equal across R1 and R2

controls.name: fixed_source_cases
controls.purpose: Keep source relation content constant across witness modes
controls.implementation: Use the two registered counterexample cases R1 and R2.

controls.name: fixed_projection_rule
controls.implementation: Use C1:: plus source or target value.

controls.name: explicit_predicate_components
controls.implementation: Evaluate typed relation, endpoint, identity, trace, and history fields separately.

random_seed.seed_scope: deterministic finite cases; no random generation

termination_conditions: Any source relation, endpoint, or witness token is missing.
Any predicate component is evaluated using an undeclared rule.
No post-hoc expansion of cases or witness fields.

decision_rules: Report whether the enriched witness passes the declared finite candidate predicate.
Preserve any bare/enriched mismatch as a limitation or bounded negative result.
Do not infer universal source-relation preservation from finite cases.
allowed_interpretations: Bounded witness-field behavior for the declared C1 cases.

immutability.hash_method: SHA-256 of canonical JSON with content_sha256 blanked
immutability.supersession_policy: Do not edit after execution starts; create a new spec_id for changes.
